Rectangles $S$ and $R$ are similar. The ratio of each side length of rectangle $S$ to the corresponding
side length of rectangle $R$ is 25 to 49. The ratio of the area of rectangle $S$ to the area of rectangle
$R$ is 625 to $r$. What is the value of $r$?

$$5(9x+7+c/5)=45x$$
In the given equation, $c$ is a constant. The equation has infinitely many solutions. What is the
value of $c$?
